name: data-data-api
description: Use when the user asks about an instant API over a database: Hasura GraphQL, PostgREST, WunderGraph, a data gateway, real-time subscriptions or row-level authorization for data APIs. Produces API layer config with JWT/RBAC permissions, caching and rate limits. Not for hand-written REST/GraphQL services (use backend-api-design) or federation (use api-graphql-federation).
